query: Please create a responsive dating community website with 16 pages. The website should have a layout that adapts to different screen sizes, including mobile devices. Users should be able to browse different pages, including the homepage, registration page, login page, profile page, search page, chat page, and more. The website should have a responsive design to ensure consistent display across different devices. Set overall background to light slate gray, then style components with navy.

requirements.source: “Please create a responsive dating community website with 16 pages.”
